qualification.education_qualification: BASLP, B.Sc Nursing, GNM, MBBS, B.S.M.S, B.U.M.S, Diploma in Pharmacy, B.Sc Radiography
qualification.details: Audiologist & Speech Therapists: BASLP Courses from a recognized institution. Occupational Therapist: Bachelors / Master’s Degree in Occupational Therapy from a recognized University. Audio metrician: Pass 12th grade with science subjects, followed by a one-year certificate course in audiometry from a government or recognized institution, or a Diploma in Hearing Language and Speech (DHLS). Radiographer: B.Sc Radiography. OT Assistant: 3 Months OT Technician Course from recognized University/Institutions. Mid-Level Health Provider: Diploma in GNM/B.Sc Nursing from recognized University/Institution. Multi-Purpose Hospital Worker: Should have studied minimum 8th Standard. Must be able to read and write. ANM: ANM qualification from Government or Government approved private Auxiliary Nurse Midwife School which is recognized by Indian Nursing Council. Genetic Counsellor: Bachelor’s Degree in Sociology/Psychology/Social Work/Diploma in GNM/B.Sc Nursing from a recognized University or institution. Additionally, the candidate must belong to a tribal community, preferably from the same district. Siddha Doctor: Minimum bachelor degree (B.S.M.S) from recognized university. Unani Doctor: Minimum bachelor degree (B.U.M.S) from recognized university. Dispenser: Diploma in Integrated pharmacy course (for certificate issued by Govt of Tamilnadu only). Therapeutic Assistant: Diploma in Nursing therapy (for certificate issued by Govt. of Tamilnadu only). Ayush Multipurpose Worker: Should have studied minimum 8th Standard. Must be able to read and write. District Quality Consultant: Basic Degree: Dental/AYUSH/ Nursing/ Social Science/ Life Science Graduates with Post Graduation: Master Degree in Hospital Administration (MHA)/ Public Health (MPH)/ Health Management (MHM) with 2 years’ experience in Health Administration. Programme Cum Administrative Assistant: Recognized Graduate Degree with fluency in MS Office Package with one year experience of managing office and providing support of Health programme / National Mission(NRHM). Senior DOTs-Plus & TBHIV Supervisor (District PMDT TB-HIV Coordinator): Graduate, Certificate Course in Computer Operation (Minimum two months), Permanent two wheeler driving license, At least 2 years of work experience under NTEP or 5 Years’ experience in any public health programme in a supervisory capacity. Senior Tuberculosis Laboratory Supervisor (STLS): Graduate and Diploma in Medical Laboratory technology or equivalent from a govt Recognized institution, Permanent two Wheeler driving license, Certificate Course in Computer Operation (Minimum 2 months), Minimum one year of experience in NTEP. Medical Officer (UHWC): Minimum MBBS degree recognized by Medical Council of India registered in Tamilnadu medical council. ICTC- Counsellor: Graduate degree holder in Psychology/Social Work/Sociology/Anthropology/Human development/Nursing with 3 years of experience in counselling/ educating under National Health Programme or PG in relevant field with 1 year experience.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DHS Dindigul Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://dindigul.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DHS Dindigul recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DHS Dindigul Various Contractual Health Posts is 21st August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 36 vacancies announced for various contractual health posts by the District Health Society Dindigul.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum qualification required for the Multi-Purpose Hospital Worker post?
faq.answer: For the Multi-Purpose Hospital Worker post, candidates should have studied a minimum of 8th Standard and must be able to read and write.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Medical Officer (UHWC) post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Medical Officer (UHWC) post is Rs.63000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. Which organization has released this recruitment notification?
faq.answer: The recruitment notification has been released by the District Health Society Dindigul (DHS Dindigul).

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection process steps for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts includes Document Verification and the creation of a Merit List.

faq.question: Q9. What is the qualification for the Genetic Counsellor post?
faq.answer: The qualification for the Genetic Counsellor post is a Bachelor’s Degree in Sociology/Psychology/Social Work/Diploma in GNM/B.Sc Nursing, and the candidate must belong to a tribal community.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of DHS Dindigul, which is https://dindigul.nic.in.
